signIn.title: Patient sign-in
signIn.smsHint: Enter your phone number — we will send an SMS code.
signIn.loginLead: If you have already booked at this clinic, enter your phone number — we will send an SMS code.
signIn.registerLead: If this is your first visit, fill in your details and receive an SMS code.
signIn.devBody: If SMS is not configured, read the one-time code in the API server log (Redis key / send-code output).
signIn.orSocial: Or sign in with a social network:
signIn.consentPd: I agree to personal data processing under the
signIn.policyMissing: Policy text is not set. Contact the clinic.
signIn.consentMailing: I agree to receive clinic news (promos, reminders)

home.noUpcomingHint: Book a visit — pick a dentist and a time that works.
home.onlineLead: Pick a convenient time without calling the clinic.

booking.title: Book a visit
booking.noDoctors: No dentists available for this service
booking.noSlots: No free slots on this date

chat.title: Clinic chat
chat.lead: Conversation with clinic staff (no third-party messengers). A message you delete still remains in the admin history. Up to 5 MB: documents, photos, audio — microphone button or file; video circles are not used.
chat.clearBody: Delete all of your messages from this chat? The administrator keeps the conversation history.
chat.emptyHint: Write or send a voice note (microphone) — staff will reply. You can attach a photo or a document.
chat.placeholder: Message… (Shift+Enter new line, Enter to send)
chat.voiceHint: Voice via microphone or audio file; a caption on the attachment is optional.

profile.title: Profile
profile.cashback: Cashback from visits. You can spend it when booking.
profile.emptyWallet: Balance and memberships appear after visits.
profile.giftLead: Share the link — your friend gets a bonus when they book.
profile.shareText: Book with my link and get a visit bonus!

store.title: Store
store.pickClinic: Select a clinic in the app.
store.offHint: The clinic owner can enable the store in admin: Commerce — patient app block.
store.askChat: Questions about products — write in clinic chat.
store.rateLimit: Too many requests. Wait a minute and tap Retry.
store.lead: Clinic assortment. In-app checkout comes in a later version — confirm stock and price in chat.
store.emptyHint: An administrator will add products in Commerce nomenclature.

history.title: Visit history
history.emptyHint: Book a visit from Quick book.

success.paid: Payment succeeded. We look forward to seeing you.
success.wait: We look forward to seeing you.

feed.title: Feed
feed.lead: Clinic promos, news, and offers. Stories are short; posts have the full story.

forms.fillHint: Fill in the fields. Asterisks mark required answers.
